title: Is a 4% Safe Withdrawal Rate Actually Safe?

scenes.text: Myth: A 4% withdrawal always preserves wealth.
scenes.label: 4% Withdrawal Rule

scenes.text: Truth: In 2023, 30‑year Treasury yields hit 6%; a 4% rule is riskier than you think.
scenes.label: Higher Bond Yields

scenes.text: Takeaway: Match withdrawals to current market yields.
scenes.label: Match to Yields

scenes.text: Follow for the money mindset they don't teach you.

description: The 4% rule has guided retirees for decades, but rising bond yields make it risky. Learn why adjusting withdrawals to current rates matters. Follow for more money‑smart myths busted!
